title: Concept: SHA-1 selected by name (powershell) — review required
description: In powershell, naming SHA-1 (Get-FileHash.*-Algorithms+SHA1) requests a deprecated digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string. The powershell-specific remedy is selecting -Algorithm SHA256.
applicability: powershell codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
